snippet.title: HAYWIRE trailer - Ludum Dare 59
snippet.description:
Haywire is a 3rd-person fighting game where every strike is driven by signals sent directly from your brain to your body.

Set in a biopunk world, you fight to stay in control as your own mind becomes your greatest challenge.

Game links:
https://hirqshi.itch.io/haywire
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/59/haywire
